notes: vMLX 1.6.34 — Major stability release: fixed a store-path memory explosion that could silently kill the engine minutes after a long-context turn (and, with a raised GPU wired limit, wedge the whole machine). Native MTP now actually engages by default and runs 38-48 t/s warm on Qwen3.8-27B; DFlash2 speculative decoding sustains 60+ t/s with multiturn prefix reuse (~20x faster warm TTFT). Qwen-family video input works. dots3-note deep-context conversations verified to 42-56k tokens, with a clear wired-limit advisory when the OS ceiling is reached. Removed the RAM preflight that refused large model loads. Stream interval defaults to 8 so long conversations can no longer stall the engine from the renderer. Both DMGs are Developer ID signed, notarized by Apple, and stapled.
